estimate_label: Proposed range. This is a planning estimate, not a quote, and it has not been calibrated against delivered work.
cannot_infer: a cited passage -> the source system matches it, or the upstream project supports this customer's case
an inventory-stated criterion -> a verified or accepted criterion; only a reviewer with authorized access can verify it
a proposed range -> a price, a quote, an invoice or permission to spend
a proposed task -> admitted work, provider access, or authority to touch the customer's systems
a license mention in a README -> the license of the code, or rights to adopt or republish it

types.title: Hosting account move assessment
types.recipient: the account owner moving sites off an InterWorx, cPanel, Plesk or Virtualmin server

criteria.text: Every site, domain, mailbox and database on the source account is listed before anything moves.
A frozen copy of the source account exists and can be restored without the old host.
DNS records and their current TTLs are recorded, so the cutover can be reversed.
Mail keeps arriving during the move and old mail is copied with folder structure intact.

estimate.basis: reviewer hours per site for inventory, staged copy, mail sync and cutover check

tasks.title: Read the authorized account inventory
Confirm a restorable frozen copy of the source
Stage the copy on the destination without cutover
Review DNS and mail cutover with the account owner

types.title: PHP site rescue assessment
types.recipient: the owner of a PHP or WordPress site stuck on an old PHP version

criteria.text: The current PHP version and the target version are both named.
Plugins, themes and custom code are listed, with the ones nobody maintains marked.
The site runs in a throwaway copy on the target version before the live site changes.

estimate.basis: reviewer hours for compatibility scan, fixes on a copy, and a rehearsal pass

tasks.title: Read the authorized PHP and plugin inventory
Scan the copy for target-version incompatibilities
Rehearse the upgrade on a throwaway copy

types.title: SQL and ERP migration assessment
types.recipient: the team moving a database or an Odoo/ERP install to a new engine or version

criteria.text: Source and destination engines and versions are named.
Tables, views, procedures, triggers and permissions are counted on the source.
Row counts, types, constraints and a sample of query results match between source and a rehearsal copy.
A rollback point exists and the time to restore it is known.

estimate.basis: reviewer hours for object mapping, rehearsal conversion and diff review per database

tasks.title: Read the authorized schema and object inventory
Map types, procedures and constraints from the cited conversion rules
Convert into a rehearsal copy
Record row, type and query diffs as receipts

types.title: CAD and IFC model migration assessment
types.recipient: the design or facilities team moving drawings and building models between tools

criteria.text: Source file formats and schema versions are named (for example IFC2X3 or IFC4).
A representative sample model is provided under the customer's authorization.
What must stay editable after the move (walls, openings, properties) is written down.

estimate.basis: reviewer hours for format check, sample conversion and geometry/property comparison

tasks.title: Read the authorized model inventory and sample
Convert the sample and compare geometry and properties
Review upstream tool licenses before any code adoption

types.title: Civic legacy system modernization assessment
types.recipient: a public agency or nonprofit replacing an old data portal, forms system or rules engine

criteria.text: The datasets, forms and rules in the current system are listed, with any personal data marked.
Each rule or policy carries the date it took effect, so old cases still compute the old way.
What the public can read today stays readable after the move.

estimate.basis: reviewer hours for inventory, rule and dataset mapping, and a parallel-run plan

tasks.title: Read the authorized system inventory
Mark personal data and the rules that govern it
Plan a parallel run against the old system

types.title: Migration verification and rollback plan
types.recipient: whoever signs off a migration and needs proof it worked and a way back if it did not

criteria.text: The source site or system is captured before the move so it can be compared afterwards.
A restore from backup has been performed once, with the time it took recorded.
A named person signs off the comparison before the old system is retired.

estimate.basis: reviewer hours for before/after capture, comparison and a restore drill

tasks.title: Capture the source before the move
Run and time one restore from backup
Compare before and after captures for sign-off

types.title: Document and archive extraction assessment
types.recipient: a records or operations team moving scanned files, PDFs and office documents into a searchable archive

criteria.text: The document formats and rough counts are listed, including scans that need OCR.
Who owns the documents and what may be kept, shown or shared is recorded for each collection.
The kinds of personal data to detect or redact are named, and a person approves the rules before any run.

estimate.basis: reviewer hours for a sample extraction, metadata mapping and a personal-data rule review

tasks.title: Read the authorized document inventory and sample
Extract the sample and compare text, tables and metadata
Agree the personal-data rules before anything is extracted at scale
Review upstream tool and model licenses before adoption
